b.x: What it is — and what the video sold

Counter-surveillance, in gray craft, is noticing that someone is mapping you — and leaving the scene without becoming a stage. It is not hunting the watcher. It is not losing a tail like the film. Professional surveillance (a foot team, a relief car, a technician in a box, a detection route) is the work of the State and of whoever the law authorised. This notebook does not teach playing that game. Whoever tries, on the asphalt, against trained people, confirms they saw and hands over the map of the house.

The advanced thing the survivalist needs is already in this notebook, deeper: secrecy (who knows what), digital (cloud, location, photo), cluster (three signals, not one), trap (too sweet), emergency numbers. What the channel calls advanced — an RF detector, a theatrical Faraday bag, ‘how to lose the black car’, an SDR-style detection route — is a stage. It buys fear. It does not hold Tuesday.
What this field refuses
Does not teach losing a tail on foot or in a car. Not a three-box, not looping the block as a test, not cutting a signal.
Does not teach sweeping a bug, opening a lining, finding a tracker on the chassis like a film mechanic.
Does not teach interfering with a camera, radio, GPS, a plate. In Brazil that is a crime, not craft.
Does not teach evading authority. If the watcher is the law, you do not play. Obey.
Does not teach watching back. Gray counter-surveillance does not become illegal surveillance.
DON'T
If the reason is vanishing from a lawsuit, child support, police, a debt — stop. This notebook is not an accomplice. Gray margin belongs to a lawful family.
The street’s advanced: the cluster

One face at the stop, another at the grocer, the same car two streets later: alone it proves nothing. Three times, three places, the same direction — that is a cluster, the same craft as the micro-expression field and the trap field. Gray does not confirm. Does not stare. Does not photograph the ‘suspect’ for the group. Does not test by looping the block: the test is a stage and, if they are professional, the stage was what they wanted.
01 Note it. Do not stare. Do not perform.
02 Move to a public, populated place: a shop, a station, a staffed lobby. Not home, not an alley.
03 A short note to the contact: ‘I am on the plan’. No map in the audio.
04 If the cluster holds and the chest tightens: emergency services. Stalking and threat are crimes. The law is the advanced tool.
05 Do not bring the problem to the family’s door to ‘be sure’.
When it is stalking, not a drill

An ex, a neighbour, a stranger who keeps appearing. In Brazil, stalking is a crime. Maria da Penha covers threat and domestic violence. Advanced counter-surveillance, in this case, is not a detector: it is a report, a protective order, a witness, not posting the new address, not answering the game. The survivalist who ‘handles it on the street’ hands over the scene and loses the law.
Note date, place, what you saw — on paper, without confronting.
Emergency services / women’s precinct / public defender. Not the prepper group.
Point B and routes: whoever needs to know, knows. The feed does not.
Child: school told what is needed, no theater, no map in the parents’ group.
DO
The advanced tool is the authority. Gray uses the law. Whoever refuses the law and chooses the machete chooses the stage.
The watch you already turned on

Before the black car: live location in a message, Find My shared with someone who did not need it, a photo with metadata, a story at the airport, craft Bluetooth. That is surveillance you signed. The digital field and operational secrecy are already the advanced layer. Without that, an RF detector is costume jewellery.
01 Turn off live location when Tuesday does not ask.
02 Revoke sharing position with an ex, a group, a training app that becomes a map.
03 Photo: background, plate, uniform, the file. If it teaches the house, it stays.
04 Do not test ‘if they follow me’ by posting bait. Bait is a stage.
Gear theater

A shop-window RF detector beeps at Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, a tower, a microwave. The gray operator does not become a spectrum technician in the living room. A Faraday bag helps store a car key against cheap remote opening — it does not ‘blank the NSA’. A signal jammer is a crime. A street camera in Brazil, when in doubt, treat as recording: do not perform, do not cover a plate, do not film the authority for the channel.
Suspect a tracker on the car: a trusted workshop and a report. Do not ‘fix it’ in the river.
Suspect a bug in the house: do not disarm alone what may be evidence. Authority.
Buying a wand and posting the unboxing is the opposite of secrecy.
Tuesday’s drill

Advanced, in this notebook, is this: awareness without a stage. One ear on the street. A cluster, not one signal. A public place if the chest tightens. The law on the tongue. Secrecy and digital in order. No film route, no wand, no lost tail. Kits has the list. The secrecy field is the hygiene. This field is refusing the game.
DO
If the cluster holds: public, a note, emergency services. Not home. No test. No channel.
NOTE
Educational content. Not a substitute for police, a lawyer, a protective order, or a live course. It does not teach evading lawful surveillance or losing a tail.
